visibleTestCases.title: Atomic Endpoint Counter Updates
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin catch ets:delete(telemetry_store), ok = ets_telemetry:init_table(), 1 = ets_telemetry:record_endpoint_hit(<<"/api/v1/checkout">>, 1), 5 = ets_telemetry:record_endpoint_hit(<<"/api/v1/checkout">>, 4), ets_telemetry:get_endpoint_hits(<<"/api/v1/checkout">>) end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Verifies table creation and atomic update_counter increments.

visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin ok = ets_telemetry:init_table(), ok = ets_telemetry:put_user_profile(101, <<"Alice">>, admin), {ok, P} = ets_telemetry:get_user_profile(101), {maps:get(name, P), maps:get(role, P)} end
